description: This file contains test helper functions and mocks for testing isolated agent turns in a cron job context, including functions to mock embedded payloads, read session entries, and run test scenarios with different configurations.

methods.name: makeDeps
methods.description: Creates a CliDeps object with mocked message sending functions.

methods.name: mockEmbeddedPayloads
methods.description: Mocks the runEmbeddedPiAgent function to resolve with specified payloads.

methods.name: mockEmbeddedTexts
methods.description: Mocks embedded payloads with given texts.

methods.name: mockEmbeddedOk
methods.description: Mocks embedded payloads with a single 'ok' text.

methods.name: expectEmbeddedProviderModel
methods.description: Asserts that the last call to runEmbeddedPiAgent used expected provider and model.

methods.name: readSessionEntry
methods.description: Reads a session entry from a session store file.

methods.name: runCronTurn
methods.description: Runs a simulated cron agent turn with specified options.

methods.name: runGmailHookTurn
methods.description: Runs a cron turn with Gmail hook configuration.

methods.name: runTurnWithStoredModelOverride
methods.description: Runs a cron turn with a specific model override in the store entries.
